finding: F3 bootstrap observed transient skip button before evidence captures; original intro ended between viewport and full-page captures. Generic click then waited for removed button and timed out before sending any click.

pixel_comparison.002-before.png: Original intro, native skip button, background login obscured
pixel_comparison.002-before-full.png: Intro gone, real unobscured login form
pixel_comparison.002-after-failure.png: Byte-identical to full-page before screenshot, same unobscured login

cause_precision: Automatic app completion is supported by no click/keyboard operation in the trace, native screenshot disappearance and unmodified brand done() handlers. Trace does not distinguish video ended event from fallback timer; do not label the exact automatic mechanism as proven.

local_fix.behavior: Within existing 10-second budgets, wait for original dialog detachment, require one visible auth form and one visible/actionable native registration toggle with trial=True. Both actual registration click steps unchanged. No exceptions caught, no app writes or skip clicks.

validation.native_changed_code: Not run locally; requires authorized CI
validation.test_count_note: 66 passed tests and 3 passed subtests are separate pytest counters; 13 new intro tests are included in the 66, not additional.

scope_limit: Original F3 result remains blocked_or_error; this diagnosis does not establish its financial report assertion passed.
evidence_scope: Offline inspection of official GitHub CI artifacts and pure local protocol regressions only. No local browser, listener, application patch or external provider calls.
